headline: Marketing Coordinator
summary: Marketing coordinator with three years organising promotional campaigns and events for a regional appliance retailer in Bicol. I plan campaign calendars, coordinate store events and trade-fair booths, and design the posters and tarpaulins that go with them.
skills: Canva for posters, tarpaulins and flyers
Project coordination with stores and suppliers

experience.title: Marketing Coordinator
bullets: Plan the yearly promotions calendar for 14 branches with the marketing manager.
Organise mall and plaza activations for Christmas, back-to-school and Kasanggayahan Festival season.
Coordinate supplier-funded promotions with appliance brands and track their materials and deadlines.
Design posters, tarpaulins and price tags in Canva for every branch.
Ran a trade-in promo that sold 900 refrigerators in six weeks.

experience.title: Events Assistant
bullets: Helped set up product launches and school fairs for local businesses.
Prepared event checklists and supplier contact sheets.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration, major in Marketing Management
